title: Does Lidocaine Gel Decrease Pain Perception in Women Undergoing Diagnostic Flexible Cystoscopy
brief_summary: This study is to determine if there is a clinically meaningful difference in pain perception for women during in-office diagnostic flexible cystoscopy when using lidocaine gel vs plain lubricant. This will be a double blinded randomized control trial.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* need for in office diagnostic flexible cystoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* urethral stricture
* simultaneous scheduling or performed additional procedure
* current urinary tract infection
* hypersensitivity to local anesthetic of amide type
